name: Aircall
label: Aircall — Aircall Public API v1
description: Aircall via the official Aircall Public API v1. Base https://api.aircall.io/v1. Docs: https://developer.aircall.io/api-references/ and https://developer.aircall.io/docs/send-and-receive-sms-proxy-mode. start-call is POST /users/{id}/calls. send-message is POST /numbers/{id}/messages/send (number must be configured for API messaging). Call recordings are personal data and may require two-party consent. listen = Aircall webhooks as BPMN message events. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Aircall operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"start-call"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: start-call | transfer-call | comment-call | tag-call | archive-call | get-call | search-calls | create-contact | update-contact | delete-contact | send-message | create-user | update-user | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Call, contact, user, or Aircall number id. start-call: Aircall user id (POST /v1/users/{id}/calls; number_id + to in body). send-message: Aircall number id (POST /v1/numbers/{id}/messages/send; to + body in the body). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: to
schema.description: Destination E.164 for start-call / send-message. Example: +14155552671.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Comment body for comment-call.

schema.label: body
schema.description: SMS body for send-message.

schema.label: number_id
schema.description: Aircall number id for start-call.

schema.label: user_id
schema.description: Aircall user id to transfer the call to (transfer-call body `user_id`). Set exactly one of user_id, team_id or number. Example: 456.

schema.label: team_id
schema.description: Aircall team id to transfer the call to (transfer-call body `team_id`). Set exactly one of user_id, team_id or number. Example: 1234.

schema.label: number
schema.description: External E.164 phone number to transfer the call to (transfer-call body `number`). Set exactly one of user_id, team_id or number. Example: +14155552671.

schema.label: dispatching_strategy
schema.description: Optional team-transfer dispatching (transfer-call with team_id only). EXACT: random | simultaneous | longest_idle; Aircall defaults to simultaneous. Example: longest_idle.

schema.label: phone_number
schema.description: Query-string parameter `phone_number` for search-calls (E.164 number the calls involved). Example: +14155552671.

schema.label: tags
schema.description: Array of Aircall tag IDs for tag-call (body `tags`; tags are created by admins in the Dashboard). Example: [545].

schema.label: from
schema.description: Query-string parameter `from` for operation: search-calls.

schema.label: per_page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `per_page` for operation: search-calls.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page` for operation: search-calls.

schema.label: first_name
schema.description: First name: contact (create-contact / update-contact) or user (create-user, mandatory; update-user). Example: Jeffrey.

schema.label: last_name
schema.description: Last name: contact (create-contact / update-contact) or user (create-user, mandatory; update-user). Example: Curtis.

schema.label: phone_numbers
schema.description: Contact phone_numbers array [{label, value}] for create-contact (mandatory there) / update-contact; at most 20 entries. Example: [{"label":"Work","value":"+14155552671"}].

schema.label: mediaUrl
schema.description: Request-body parameter `mediaUrl` for operation: send-message.

schema.label: email
schema.description: User email for create-user (mandatory, with first_name and last_name). Example: jeffrey.curtis@example.com.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: start-call, transfer-call, comment-call, tag-call, archive-call, get-call, search-calls, create-contact, update-contact, delete-contact, send-message, create-user, update-user, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: API token
configurationParameters.description: Aircall API token. HTTP Basic api_id:api_token. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: API ID
configurationParameters.description: Aircall API ID used as HTTP Basic username, paired with api_token.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
